summary: John Topping of Wing, Buckinghamshire, and Totternhoe, Bedfordshire (1578–1623), father of Capt. Thomas Topping; John's 12th-great-grandfather.
bio: John Topping was baptized at Wing in Buckinghamshire on 6 July 1578 and was buried at Totternhoe in Bedfordshire on 12 August 1623. He was the father of Capt. Thomas Topping. Earlier generations of the family at Leighton Buzzard, a Richard and a Henry Topping, have been suggested but rest on no documented evidence and remain speculative.
